calendar.both: native date plus visibly 24-hour text time (HH:mm; optional :ss.SSS), inputmode numeric
calendar.initialDateChoice: 09:00 in explicit client timezone for both; selected date and displayed default are explicit UI choices
calendar.precision: saved seconds/milliseconds preserved, not rounded to minutes
calendar.clear: valid date empty clears; time empty/partial retains invalid proposal; badInput never clears
calendar.persistence: Due->due_at ISO/null; Defer->deferUntil ISO/release; same strict DST resolver; no render writes

actionCreation.allViews: enabled regardless checked lifecycle/defer/History/Perspective; only write gate blocks
actionCreation.selection: only an explicit current visible object/occurrence; retained off-view inspector does not count
actionCreation.selectedAction: Selected existing visible Action is containment parent regardless lifecycle. New Action stays ordinary active; existing parent lifecycle/dates never change.
actionCreation.classification: Selected Action keeps its own direct Project; a Tags occurrence additionally contributes that single exact Tag. Selected Project creates a project-assigned root; selected Tag creates a tag-associated root. No ancestor/tag/flag inheritance.
actionCreation.unselected: Root with no Project or Tags; Flagged view preserves direct flagged=true.
actionCreation.filteredOut: Returned UUID is temporarily revealed as an exact row under its appropriate branch and opened in inspector, regardless current filter; no filter changes; Close/Back retain reachable route.
actionCreation.frozen: context frozen at click; validate parent/catalog existence before write without silent rebasing; unknown exact replay immutable
actionCreation.reply: Matching invocation/selection epoch alone opens the inspector. Explicit later navigation expires temporary reveal; retained generated ID remains reachable. Full snapshot read failure preserves exact unknown request; valid applied receipt with a subsequently missing record is confirmed-but-unavailable without selection or duplicate creation.

catalogCreation.API: project_add/tag_add name empty, server UUID/resolved receipt; backend owns new empty-name/migration contract
catalogCreation.header: samekind view selected catalog or selected Action catalog occurrence ->parent; other view switches to target full tree then root; no inline header composer
catalogCreation.success: select exact resolved UUID/focus Name after full snapshot and UI invocation-token guard; newer navigation/composition wins
catalogCreation.display: Untitled project/Untitled tag is presentation-only; raw name/path identity remains exact; no invented saved values
catalogCreation.recovery: Validate same-kind resolved UUID/created proof; retain exact request on read failure/malformed proof. Valid applied receipt with normal full snapshot and missing record retains the ID as confirmed-unavailable, without recreating or focusing.
